gaps.title: Button height apart from density
gaps.note: America.gov sizes buttons by place, not by density: 56px with 24px padding in forms and section CTAs, 44px with 20px in the header and lists, 64px with 36px at 18px for hero CTAs, all at 16px text
gaps.standin: `density: touch`: 48px at 24px padding and 16px text (-8px on the form button), 56px at lg

gaps.title: Segmented control height
gaps.note: The Menu sheet's theme switcher: a 36px tinted track with 4px padding around 28px circular icon items (36px on phones)
gaps.standin: `density: touch` draws a 52px track around 46px items

gaps.title: Tooltip size
gaps.note: 36px white pills padded 12px at 12/500

gaps.title: Progress track height
gaps.note: The fraud page's Before / Now bars are 12px pills on ink at 5% (8% in dark); the roadmap mockups' step bars are 4px on ink at 10%

gaps.title: Badge size
gaps.note: The "New" pill is 26px tall, padded 8px, at 12/500

gaps.title: Checkbox size
gaps.note: 20px checkboxes with 6px corners beside 16px text
gaps.standin: 16px at 2px corners (`checkCorner: sharp`); Auto rounds them to circles at this radius

gaps.title: Quiet button size
gaps.note: Footer links are ghost buttons 40px tall, padded 12px

gaps.title: Quiet buttons square while the rest are pills
gaps.note: The footer's ghost links and the language select take 8px corners; every filled button is a pill

gaps.title: Quiet button weight
gaps.note: Footer ghost links at 16/400 in pure black (white in dark)

gaps.title: Superellipse corners
gaps.note: `.squircle` boxes (cards, bento tiles, carousels, the Before / Now figure) set `corner-shape: superellipse(1.3)` and scale their radius by 1.194 where supported: `rounded-48` computes 57.312px

gaps.title: Heading sizes
gaps.note: Rhymes headlines run 96px for page headings (80px on policy pages, 144px on the home and About heroes) and 64px for section headings, from clamp() type tokens

gaps.title: A display face only for headlines
gaps.note: Rhymes Text sets page and section headlines only; policy section headings are Helvetica Now Display 24/400 and card titles Helvetica Now Text 18/500
gaps.standin: `headingFont` sets every heading level in Newsreader

gaps.title: Card titles heavier than headlines
gaps.note: Card and table titles are 18/500 under 400-weight headlines

gaps.title: Per-role letter spacing
gaps.note: Body and control text at -0.03em (-0.48px at 16px), headlines at -0.05 to -0.06em (-5.76px at 96px, -3.2px at 64px)

gaps.title: Field labels at the control size
gaps.note: Labels are 16/400, the same size as field values

gaps.title: Tooltip weight
gaps.note: Tooltips at 12/500

gaps.title: 16px body and secondary text
gaps.note: Body copy, placeholders and helper text are 16/400 (the composer's placeholder, policy paragraphs, field help); 21px for FAQ questions and lead text
gaps.standin: `density: touch` sets 16px controls but 14px secondary text

gaps.title: Prose links at body weight
gaps.note: Policy and FAQ links keep the paragraph's color and 400 weight with a solid underline 4px below

gaps.title: A navy-black ink
gaps.note: `text-primary` is blue-900 #000c1f (OKLCH 0.154 / 0.047 at hue 253): darker and far more chromatic than the grays, which are that ink at an alpha
gaps.standin: the engine's text step, OKLCH 0.240 / 0.013 at the same hue (ΔE 0.092)

gaps.title: Pure white ink in dark
gaps.note: Dark text is #ffffff

gaps.title: Body copy in secondary ink
gaps.note: Paragraphs take `text-secondary`, ink at 65% (#59616d on white, #a9aaac on #0b0d12); headings, labels and controls keep the full ink
gaps.standin: body text in the primary ink (ΔE 0.250 / 0.218)

gaps.title: Muted ink at 45%
gaps.note: `text-tertiary` is ink at 45%: #8c919a on white, #797a7c on the dark page
gaps.standin: the engine's muted step, darker in light and lighter in dark (ΔE 0.156 / 0.197)

gaps.title: A navy accent that turns mid-blue in dark
gaps.note: blue-700 is #002664 in light and #0066c5 in dark (hover blue-800 #00163b / #1a75d0): the primary button, checks and selected pharmacy pins all switch

gaps.title: A link blue apart from the navy brand
gaps.note: The `link` token is blue-500 #0066c5 (#66aef5 in dark): action and source links with a dotted underline 3px below, the roadmap step bars and the "Now" bar

gaps.title: Progress fill in the link blue
gaps.note: Bar fills take `link` #0066c5 / #66aef5, or ink at 45% for the "Before" bar

gaps.title: Emphasis badge in the ink
gaps.note: The "New" pill fills with `text-primary`: #000c1f under white text, white under #000c1f in dark
gaps.standin: the accent badge in navy (ΔE 0.153 light, 0.720 dark)

gaps.title: Segmented chip on a faint ring
gaps.note: The theme switcher's indicator is a white pill with `shadow-widget`: a 1px ring at ink 5% plus 0 10px 40px #010e2414
gaps.standin: `segmentedSelected: raised` draws its edge in the strong control line (ΔE 0.330)

gaps.title: Overlays ringed while cards have no edge
gaps.note: Menus, dialogs and tooltips carry a 1px ring at ink 5% (white 5% in dark) inside `shadow-widget`; tinted cards and panels have no edge
gaps.standin: `surfaceEdge: none` drops the overlay ring too

gaps.title: Dark overlays on the page tone
gaps.note: In dark the Menu sheet, dialogs and tooltips stay on the page color #0b0d12, set apart only by the white 5% ring

gaps.title: Page-colored fields with no inner shade
gaps.note: Textareas are clear boxes on the page with a 1px `border-secondary` edge in both modes
gaps.standin: `inputStyle: inset` adds a 1px inner top shade (4% in light, 24% in dark); Outline tints the dark fill instead

gaps.title: Ghost select
gaps.note: The only select is the footer's native language picker: transparent, a transparent 1px border, 8px corners, 44px, 12px padding, 16/400 in black

gaps.title: Focus ring over a white line
gaps.note: Buttons, links and checkboxes focus with `0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0c0c0c` in both modes, so dark shows a white 2px band around the control; fields recolor their edge to `ring` (#0c0c0c, white in dark) and add a 1px inset ring
gaps.standin: `focusColor: neutral`: a 2px ink ring (white in dark) 2px off over the page color

gaps.title: The chat composer as a pill
gaps.note: The "Ask anything" composer is an 82px white pill with a 1px ring at ink 5% and `elevation-1`, ghost Upload PDF and Voice input buttons and a navy circular Send
gaps.standin: search fields take the 15px field box

gaps.title: Tables with no outer frame
gaps.note: The fraud page's tables: header cells 16/400 in secondary ink, 1px rules at ink 10% between rows, 24px vertical cell padding, no frame or header band
gaps.standin: the table sits in a framed card

gaps.title: Segmented items in secondary ink
gaps.note: Unselected theme-switcher icons take `text-secondary`, ink at 65% (#555d6a on the tinted track, #aeaeb0 in dark)

gaps.title: Progress track darker than the panel
gaps.note: The Before / Now tracks are ink at 5% (8% in dark) laid over the tinted figure, so they read darker than the panel: #e6e9ec on the light card, #292b2f in dark
gaps.standin: the track takes the same tonal step as the card

gaps.title: Pill-ended progress fill
gaps.note: Bar fills are pills inside the pill track

gaps.title: Quiet buttons in pure black
gaps.note: Footer ghost links are #000000 (#ffffff in dark), apart from the navy-black ink

gaps.title: Dark tints as white at 5%
gaps.note: In dark the secondary button is white at 5% over the page, #17191e
gaps.standin: one tonal step up, a little lighter (ΔE 0.023)

gaps.title: Dark segmented track as white at 5%
gaps.note: The theme switcher's track is white at 5% over the dark page, #17191e
gaps.standin: one tonal step up, a little lighter

gaps.title: A near-black focus ring
gaps.note: Rings are `ring` #0c0c0c, a neutral black apart from the navy-black ink
gaps.standin: `focusColor: neutral` with `controlEdge: strong` rings in the text ink

gaps.title: Focused field edge in the ring color
gaps.note: Focus recolors the textarea's 1px edge to `ring` (#0c0c0c, white in dark) and adds a 1px inset ring
gaps.standin: `focusInputStyle: border` at `thick` draws a 2px edge in the text ink

gaps.title: Dialog title centered in the header
gaps.note: The Submit feedback dialog centers its 16/500 sans title, with a 36px tinted circular close at the right
gaps.standin: the title sits left in the heading face

gaps.title: Accordion questions at 21/400
gaps.note: FAQ questions are 21/400 in the ink, in 64px rows with 16px block padding

gaps.title: Tall table rows
gaps.note: The fraud page's tables run 97px rows: 24px block padding and 32px between columns around 16/400 cells with agency seals
